verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several fixed event-to-action mechanisms. Snowpipe loads files automatically as soon as they arrive in a stage, and resource monitors let you set a credit-limit rule that suspends a warehouse. Streams record DML changes "so that actions can be taken," and notification integrations send cost-anomaly alerts. None of this shows a general user-defined rule engine: streams only capture changes, and nothing shows how actions are actually fired from them. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose event triggers or alerts (e.g., tasks or alerts that run arbitrary actions on conditions), documentation linking streams to automated action execution, AI-native or agent-driven rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
